title: When the Signal Falls Again
author: Wendell Hartwell
blurb: Zephyrine Thornbury, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
